# P36.7 — Procurement and programme registers (3) (R11-ACQ-11)

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-INGEST-027/028** (every new row carries `compact_status`/`custody_posture`/`ingestion_permitted=false`; the loader gate refuses all three new sources until the operator's flip) · **P8-6** (natural-person payees/contacts dropped mechanically — the WA DES `customer_type` allowlist admits only reviewed public-entity values with missing/unknown counted `excluded`, and a portal vendor/payee carrying the identity layer's affirmative `natural_person_signal` emits no `seller` claim, recorded `seller_dropped`; ambiguity alone never drops) · **P8-4 / the S1 rule** (the rebate lane emits programme-level aggregates only — `programme_area` × `programme_count` on PSA × `MONTH_YEAR`; no registrant name, address, location, device row or geometry can be constructed — `returnGeometry=false`, no registrant column exists in the layer) · the **`procured ≠ deployed`** guard (purchase records assert `seller`/`buyer`/`notice` claims, never a `deployment`) · **§26** (crawler conduct — bounded `$where` slices only; `rows_window=false` expands no unreviewed generic window) · **§3.1** (the "ward × year" design text vs the published `PSA`/`MONTH_YEAR` schema is recorded as a deviation in ADR-208 — never fabricated).
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/280_P36.7__procurement-and-programme-registers.md` (manifest row 280) · **Base:** `r11/P36.6-automated-traffic-enforcement-layers` (`dd1303fa`) · **Branch:** `r11/P36.7-procurement-and-programme-registers` · **OM-20 posture:** none — committed registry/tenant/target/cadence rows, filter config, predicates, generated artifacts, ADR and fixtures only; no deploy, no fetch, no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no gate ticked. Live legs: none.

## Why

Wave-B batch `r11-procurement-01` (`17 7 19 * *`, paused) registers three procurement and programme registers — all landing `ingestion_permitted=false` behind the HG-03 rights batches (RB-06 `a` Cook, RB-04 `a` WA DES, RB-01 `a` DC) — on the portal `where` support P35.9 landed and the `arcgis_outstatistics` aggregate transport P36.6 landed. The DC rebate register is programme-level only; the design's "ward × year" grouping does not exist in the published layer (PSA × month does), so the deviation is recorded in ADR-208 rather than fabricated.

## What ships

- **`procurement.py`:** four fail-closed extensions driven by committed tenant data (ADR-208 §5) — `exact_fields` per-term equality clauses (`upper(<field>) = '<TERM>'`) for identifier columns (WA DES's seven reviewed contract numbers `05720`/`02315`/`06316`/`04220`/`06913`/`00318`/`02702` surface reseller rows whose vendor name matches no vocabulary literal — e.g. the Axon contract); `required_field`+`required_values` folded server-side into every slice's `$where` AND enforced client-side at extract (the authoritative pass — WA DES admits only reviewed public-entity `customer_type` values; missing/empty/unlisted counts `excluded` on the index row); `composite_id_fields` (`contract_number|customer_name|vendor_name`) so a bare contract number never collapses distinct sales onto one subject; `rows_window = false` so a tenant whose reviewed surface IS the where filter expands no generic recency slice. P8-6 on portal sellers: an affirmative `natural_person_signal` drops the `seller` claim (`seller_dropped`); the ambiguity refusals keep the text claim.
- **`dot_511.py`:** `aggregate_subject_kind` (closed vocabulary `camera_site` default | `programme_area`) — a `programme_area` subject mints `programme_area:<source>:<target>:<key>` entity rows and `programme_count` claims, never a `traffic_camera` subject or `enforcement_count` claim. `aggregate_count_fields` (plural): one statistic per published measure column aliased `count_<field>`; each group row fans out one `programme_count` claim per column with `series` naming it. Multi-measure rejects `verbatim` function/discriminators; singular+plural together is a registry error.
- **Three gated sources wired:** `sources.toml` (594 registered, unchanged — +3 design-id rows, −3 generated placeholders replaced; 236 loadable unchanged): `procportal_cook_il_awards` (Cook Socrata `qh8j-6k63`; vendor+description `where` slices only), `procportal_wa_des_contract_sales` (WA DES `n8q6-4twj`; vendor `where` + seven exact contract numbers + public-entity customer allowlist, composite key), `camreg_dc_ovsjg_camera_rebate` (ArcGIS `MapServer/33` `arcgis_outstatistics` PSA × `MONTH_YEAR` over six published measure columns — `RECEIVED`/`UNDERREVIEW`/`APPROVED`/`DECLINED`/`REBATEFUND`/`CAMERAFOUNDED`; layer 34, the separate voucher programme, deliberately not a target). `runner.py`, `live_targets.toml`, `live_dispositions.toml` (placeholders resolved), `api_allowlist.toml` (three hosts), `procurement_vocab.toml`/`procurement_portal_tenants.toml` (`cook_county_il` + `washington_des` tenants), `camera_registry_targets.toml` (`dc_ovsjg_camera_rebate_by_month`), `dot_511_vocab.toml`, `ops/cadence.toml` `r11-procurement-01` (3 members, paused).
- **Ontology:** `predicates.yaml` registers `programme_area` (283; string, single; `camera_registry` D1) and `programme_count` (284; integer, multi, literal; `camera_registry` D2); `ontology/generated` regenerated (`make gen`, committed before `verify-gen`).
- **ADR-208:** the recorded deviation (PSA × `MONTH_YEAR`, not ward × year) plus the predicate/spec-shape rationale; revisit trigger registered quiet at authoring (`ADR_TRIGGERS.csv` home BL-086; Appendix F row via `spec_src` + `BUILD.sh`).
- **Fixtures + tests:** six committed fixtures (Cook awards + a person-payee row, WA DES vendor + contract-number matches, ArcGIS outStatistics + a malformed row); `test_acq11_p36_7.py` (18 tests) drives the real `pipeline.run` — claim shapes on all three lanes, the fail-closed customer gate, the P8-6 drop, the six-series fan-out, layer-34 never requested, deterministic replay + `+0` shadow.
